decision.interpretation: Event tokens are often valid, but the median logit margin is too negative for a small global event bonus to be a safe next step. A global bonus large enough to move the hard starved cases would likely disturb already-passable or overgenerated cases. Cross-variant evidence strengthens this: lower median event-margin pressure did not reliably reduce starvation in the compared v3 variants.
decision.next_step: Do not run another global decode-bonus sweep. Use selective per-step trace/oracle instrumentation on the few low-bias starved cases, or pivot to v2.1 grammar improvement if the owner wants to stop v3 local probes.
decision.reason: 8/11 starved cases need median event bias > 4.0
